1357.1001.1.description:
G.8032 ERPS Ethernet Ring

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies G.8032 ERPS Ethernet ring protection switching. Builds a multi-switch ring (with the DUT as a stack) running a G.8032 ERP instance with a defined ring protection profile, brings the ring up and confirms it converges to a healthy state. Then establishes an L2 traffic stream across the ring, fails the ring link, and verifies the ring transitions to PROTECTION mode with traffic disruption confined to a single contiguous block under threshold; on link restore it confirms the ring returns to its idle/pending state and reconverges. Config is restored and verified unchanged, with no exceptions logged.

1357.1001.2.description:
GVRP - globally enabled, not enabled on ports

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies GVRP negative behaviour when GVRP is globally enabled but not enabled on the participating ports. Configures the DUT and partner switches accordingly, then confirms that VLANs present on the neighbouring switches are NOT dynamically propagated/learned onto the DUT, i.e. no dynamic VLAN registration occurs without port-level GVRP. Config is restored and verified unchanged afterwards.

1357.1001.3.description:
GVRP - globally enabled, enabled on ports, vlan creation enabled on all switches

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies GVRP dynamic VLAN propagation when GVRP and VLAN creation are enabled globally and on the ports of all switches. Confirms that VLANs common to neighbouring switches are correctly registered and propagated to the DUT and across the connecting trunk ports as expected (both dynamic and static memberships), then reboots all devices and confirms GVRP reconverges and re-propagates the same VLANs. Config is restored and verified unchanged afterwards.

1357.1001.4.description:
Test STOAT clients using DHCP snooping

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies STOAT client discovery via DHCP snooping. Establishes the STOAT session, then injects fake clients of multiple discovery types and confirms only DHCP-snooping-derived clients are added to the STOAT database, while LLDP- and Dot1x-derived clients are NOT added because their respective discovery methods are not configured. Config is restored and verified unchanged afterwards.
